crossRefs.note: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.
translations.bsb: Now the Philistine came closer and closer to David, with his shield-bearer before him.
translations.kjv: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
translations.asv: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
